description: Fetch full metadata, primary key name, and column/field definitions for a single entity type. Read-only. Provide either `idOrName` (numeric table ID or system `tableName`) or `tableName`. Always call this before `create_rows`, `update_rows`, or `read_rows` to discover exact field names, data types, lookup targets, and required fields (such as `displayname`). Returns `{ entityType: {...}, fields: [...] }`.

idOrName.description: Numeric table ID or system `tableName` (provide either `idOrName` or `tableName`).

name: get_table
